newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz - no active role in banking revamp.
newsitem.headline: Allianz - no active role in banking revamp.

text.p: German insurer Allianz AG Holding said on Wednesday that it would not be taking an active role in landscape changes in the German banking sector.
Allianz chairman Henning Schulte-Noelle said on Wednesday he believed the German banking sector was heading for changes, although he said he did not expect any spectacular events in the short-term.
"Of course we are interested in this process but we are not in a position in which we are taking an active role in pushing the situation forward," said Schulte-Noelle.
There has been much market speculation in recent months that mergers involving the five main German banks are on the cards as the German banking sector becomes more competitive.
Schulte-Noelle said that Allianz did not want to get into traditional banking business, but that he thought the boundaries between banking and insurance were becoming looser.
